ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.5.2 is a stability-first performance cleanup. Detailed per-WorkGiver profiling is no longer resident during normal play: the 425 phase probes are installed only for a temporary 32-job-package capture started from Mod Settings, then automatically removed. Path A* remains shadow-only and Vanilla-authoritative, but its diagnostic CPU budget is now bounded at the admission layer: only one shadow path may run at a time, eligible medium-distance requests are sampled 1 in 4, high-load frames do not admit new shadow work, and validation stops after 64 paired results. This directly reduces profiler and duplicate-path CPU overhead without changing Vanilla Job selection, PawnPath, reservations, or gameplay state. V0.4.5 PathGrid invalidation deduplication, finalize-generation stale protection, and the validated Butter++ logical-tick barrier are retained.
